aws-glue-data-catalog:rest-spec-support:.notes: Dedicated Iceberg REST endpoint (glue.{region}.amazonaws.com/iceberg) implementing the spec's namespace and table operations with SigV4 auth and Lake Formation credential vending.
caveats: View APIs of the Iceberg REST spec are not supported
RenameTable works for Redshift-managed tables but not for tables in Amazon S3
Iceberg table metadata is capped at 50 MB (5 MB per call through catalog federation)

aws-glue-data-catalog:v2-spec-support:cu.notes: Format v2 Iceberg tables are the standard in the Data Catalog, including the managed compaction and snapshot-retention optimizers.

aws-glue-data-catalog:v3-spec-support:cu.notes: Iceberg v3 deletion vectors and row lineage are supported (announced November 2025) across the Glue Data Catalog, S3 Tables and AWS analytics engines.
caveats: The v3 announcement covers deletion vectors and row lineage; the new v3 data types (variant, geometry/geography, nanosecond timestamps) haven't been announced for the Data Catalog

aws-glue-data-catalog:managed-offering:c.notes: Fully managed and serverless: no catalog operations.

aws-glue-data-catalog:serves-own-irc:cur.notes: The Iceberg REST endpoint serves its own tables read and write to external engines, with spec-compliant Lake Formation vended credentials.

aws-glue-data-catalog:rw-foreign-irc:cur.notes: AWS engines can read external sources via federation but cannot write to them: foreign-table interop is one-directional (read-only).

aws-glue-data-catalog:federation-broker:.notes: Federates external sources read-only for AWS-native engines; not a general bidirectional IRC client to arbitrary catalogs.

aws-glue-data-catalog:multi-engine-multi.notes: Broad engine support within AWS, but AWS-only rather than multi-cloud.

aws-glue-data-catalog:governance-cred-ve.notes: Lake Formation column, row and cell security plus spec-compliant vended credentials for AWS-native engines.
